title: Nutmeg Infused Spanish Almonds Tarta De Santiago
description: A romantic Spanish dessert featuring puff pastry and a briny, molten center, made with dairy-free friendly ingredients. This tarta de santiago is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a mortar, pound the sliced almonds and grated nutmeg until coarsely chopped.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, sea salt, and lemon juice.
Brush the olive oil mixture evenly over the center of the puff pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Spoon the almond and nutmeg mixture over the olive oil mixture.
Fold the edges of the puff pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the aquafaba over the puff pastry to glaze.
Sprinkle the granulated sugar over the top of the tarta de santiago.
Bake the tarta de santiago for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the center is molten.
